annotations.text:
Landing page.
One offer, one action, repeated top and bottom. The three doubts a visitor to a health app actually has — is my data safe, do I need a wallet, can I delete it — are answered in order rather than buried.

The amber card is deliberate: leading with what the product CAN'T do yet buys the credibility the rest of the page spends.

[CONTACT EMAIL] in the footer needs your real address.

The Voice button is placed but its destination isn't designed yet — I didn't want to invent a whole mode you hadn't asked for. Worth doing: hands are busy when you're cooking, and voice sidesteps literacy and bandwidth in a way typing doesn't.
Alternate direction, low-fi. Kept beside the deliverable so the aesthetic call stays yours.

New in the top bar on every app screen: theme toggle (sun/moon segments) and a Voice control, left of the wallet chip.

The light-mode screen is reverted — the toggle stays. Light palette is derived and on file if you want it back.
